verdict.rationale: Cekura publishes a public API reference covering call ingestion and project-level API key creation, plus sync and async SDK clients. A probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at docs.cekura.ai/openapi.json, along with machine-readable llms.txt and markdown docs, so an AI-native user can discover the API and drive it programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actually calling the API endpoints (evidence is first-party docs plus a check that the spec file exists).
